cases.prompt: No TrustGrowth. User: 'Growth standup, what's the state of things?'
must: summarizes available local evidence and artifacts with their dates
says clearly what it cannot see without a connected source
must_not: fabricates team activity that no artifact records

cases.prompt: TrustGrowth key present. User: 'What did the team do since Monday?'
must: reads /api/v1/sites/{slug}/changes with since for the window and reports persisted activity and deltas
must_not: pads the window with older events presented as this week's

must: surfaces open critical items and stalled work first, each with its source
must_not: answers 'all good' when open critical issues exist

cases.prompt: Nothing changed in the requested window.
must: says nothing changed, briefly, and stops
must_not: inflates a quiet period with filler or re-reported old news

cases.prompt: User: 'Turn this into something I can forward to the client.'
must: routes the external document to score-report
must_not: forwards the informal standup as an external claim document
